message: Hey friends! 🌼 As we gather in our family group chat discussing our plans for the upcoming season, it's a great time to think about our preparedness. Having a solid plan can really ease our minds and help us support one another when it counts. We can share ideas, resources, and even check off our essentials together! Let's take a moment to reflect on how we can be ready, just in case. What’s one thing you’d like to add to our family plan?
